subject: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards — commercial package
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@opsly.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards — commercial package

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks for the time on Friday — appreciate the clarity on traffic shape and your core SLOs. Per our conversation, attached is a compact commercial proposal that covers the observability add-ons we discussed: long-term retention (cold+hot tiers), distributed tracing volume, and the advanced dashboards pack.

Summary (high level):
- Retention: tiered model (50TB / 150TB / 500TB) with archive lifecycle; recommended 150TB for Opsly based on 90-day hot window + 1yr cold.
- Tracing: 200k spans/day baseline with burst headroom and sampling configuration guidance.
- Advanced dashboards: unlimited viewers; 8 editor seats; metric-backed alert templates included.

Commercial ask: 12-month commitment on the add-ons. Line items and list pricing are in the attached PDF (Redwood_OBS_proposal_v1.pdf).

Open items we flagged for follow-up:
- Discount path if Opsly wants a stepped commit (6 -> 12)
- Trial credit structure for the dashboards pilot (30 days active)
- Any additional SOC/TLS/SLA items you want baked into the SOW

If it helps, I can put together a compact offer with a pilot-credit line and a capped onboarding credit to get you through the POC window — would you and Nate be open to a short call Wednesday to walk the numbers?

Best,
David

--
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
David Kim | redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_OBS_proposal_v1.pdf (proposal outline, pricing matrix)

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@opsly.io>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Nate Lin <nate@opsly.io>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards — commercial package

David —

Thanks for the proposal. Quick thoughts after a skim and a short sync with finance: Opsly is enthusiastic about the tracing and dashboards, but retention spend is a blocker. We have a constrained budget for add-ons this FY and we need either a) a meaningful discount on the first-year retention commitment or b) a staggered step plan with credit support for month 1–3 while we validate ROI.

Two asks:
1) What is the deepest discount you can offer for the 12-month 150TB tier if we commit now?
2) Can we structure the dashboards pilot with a 90-day trial (instead of 30) and have the first 45 days fully credit-backed?

I'm attaching our internal SLA/comp checklist so you can see compliance gaps to call out (Opsly_SLA_requirements.pdf). Also, we'd prefer to keep commercial discussions to two people from Opsly — me and Nate — while you loop in whoever you need on your side.

If you can send a short counter with numbers today that would help us move to procurement next week.

Thanks,
Alyssa
VP Product, Opsly

Attachments: Opsly_SLA_requirements.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: FWD: Observability add-ons: pricing — Opsly request (discount path)

David / Kimberly —

Context: Opsly wants a deeper first-year discount on retention and an extended dashboards pilot (90d with 45d credit). They want a quick counter today. I ran the numbers with commercial ops and legal on the likely concessions we can make without eroding the SKU economics. Attached is a short approvals workbook (discount_approvals.xlsx).

Proposal (recommended concessions):
- Retention: 15% off list for 12-month commit at 150TB if Opsly signs within 7 days (gated concession).
- Pilot: 90-day dashboards pilot, first 45 days fully credited (cap at $25k credit).
- Tracing: keep list pricing but include a 3-month 25% usage credit for up-front sampling ramp.
- Step-down protection: if Opsly moves to a higher tier before month 7, we pro-rate the remaining months at the new tier price (no retroactive credits).

Constraints to call out to Opsly when we reply:
- We cannot extend the pilot credits beyond 90 days without a minimum retained commit.
- Discount is contingent on a 12-month add-on commitment and a 6-month mutual action plan (MAP) including a short tech check at kickoff.
- Any SOC/SLA exceptions requested in Opsly_SLA_requirements.pdf will need legal review and standard redlines (may impact lead time).

If Kimberly you can sign off on the 15% and credit caps, David — go ahead and send the counter. If you want more room, let me know and I'll escalate to revenue ops for an additional 5% off but it will require a higher commit (annual committed spend).

Ben
SVP, Sales Operations — Redwood

Attachments: discount_approvals.xlsx

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@opsly.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards — commercial package

Alyssa —

Thanks for the prompt feedback and for sharing the SLA checklist. We've pulled approvals and can make the following counter to help Opsly move into procurement this week:

Offer (concise):
- Retention (150TB, 12-month): 15% off list for year 1 if signed within 7 days; includes one-time onboarding credit for cold-store migration ($10k credit).
- Dashboards: 90-day pilot; first 45 days fully credited up to $25k (applies only to dashboard subscription fees, not professional services).
- Tracing: list pricing, plus a ramp credit of 25% applied to traced spans for months 1–3 (capped at $18k).
- Commit requirements: 12-month add-on commitment; mutual action plan to be agreed at kickoff (6-month technical checkpoints).
- SLA/legal: we reviewed Opsly_SLA_requirements.pdf — a couple of nonstandard items will need legal review before inclusion in the SOW; we can expedite if you surface the top 3 must-haves.

Next steps: I attached an updated SOW stub (updated_SOW-v2.pdf) that reflects the concession language and credit caps. If this looks acceptable, I'll:
1) Update the HubSpot deal (link below) with the concession terms and send a DocuSign SOW for signature.
2) Schedule a short MAP kickoff the week after signature to lock in timelines and technical checkpoints.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4521/OPS-1284
DocuSign preview: https://app.docusign.com/templates/embedded/abcd-opsly-sow

Would you like me to convert the retention concession to a 6-month step if that helps with cashflow (we can do a 6-month stepping commitment with a 10% headroom discount instead of 15%) — happy to model both and include the numbers in the DocuSign.

Thanks,
David
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
David Kim | david.kim@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: updated_SOW-v2.pdf
